findings.location: ## Postulate, paragraph beginning ‘A time-homogeneous finite GKSL model may instead be selected…’, at T_t=e^{t\mathcal L}.
findings.evidence: The optional GKSL assignment uses the matrix/operator exponential e^{t\mathcal L} without defining it or identifying an exact earlier definition. The direct supplier def-qsm-dt-gksl-definition defines the generator \mathcal L and a propagator notion but not the operator exponential. The current dependency list has no operator-exponential supplier. The finite-dimensional power-series definition and convergence must be stated locally, or an exact exponential supplier with its hypotheses must be declared.

findings.location: Statement, paragraph beginning ‘Equality in claim 1 does not force f to vanish.’, especially ‘may be positive at infinitely many points; that is FALSE’.
findings.evidence: As written, ‘that is FALSE’ can negate the immediately preceding true assertion that such a function may be positive at infinitely many points, while the colon then restates the distinct false universal claim that every such function vanishes. The cited published counterexample fs-nonnegative-integrable-with-zero-integral-vanishes explicitly gives Thomae’s function, which is nonnegative, has integral zero, and is positive at every rational point. Rewrite the paragraph so FALSE unambiguously modifies the universal vanishing claim.
